svg.title: Bell state by braiding
svg.text: A Bell state made by braiding anyons
Swapping two anyons is the gate. A swap inside a pair only turns a phase; a swap across pairs entangles.
Start: six anyons, made as three pairs from empty space
Braid 0: swap the anyons at places 0 and 1, inside qubit 0's pair
Braid 2: swap the anyons at places 2 and 3, inside qubit 1's pair
Braid 1: swap the anyons at places 1 and 2, across two pairs
Fuse each pair to read the bits: shot 1 of 100 reads 00
Fuse each pair to read the bits: shot 2 of 100 reads 00
Fuse each pair to read the bits: shot 3 of 100 reads 00
Fuse each pair to read the bits: shot 25 of 100 reads 11
Fuse each pair to read the bits: shot 100 of 100 reads 11
A pair that fuses to 1 reads bit 0, to ψ reads bit 1. Right now both qubits read 00.
The chances stay the same. Only the phase turns, by 22.5 degrees.
Now 00 has 50%, 11 has 50%, and 01 or 10 has 0%: an entangled Bell state.
The two bits agree every time: 1 time 00 and 0 times 11 so far.
The two bits agree every time: 2 times 00 and 0 times 11 so far.
The two bits agree every time: 3 times 00 and 0 times 11 so far.
The two bits agree every time: 15 times 00 and 10 times 11 so far.
The two bits agree every time: 49 times 00 and 51 times 11 so far.
Computed in this run of BellState.fsx on the Ising backend: 2 qubits, braids 0, 2 and 1, then 100 shots.
